command.$interpolate: capcli ping notify {{principal}} "Nightly sync finished" --channel slack --intent "morning briefing"
command.$example: capcli ping notify user:root "Nightly sync finished" --channel slack --intent "morning briefing"

culprit.$example: Channel 'slack' has no webhook configured in vault.

component.remedy: Inject the channel webhook secret out-of-band — `capcli sys vault set notify_slack_webhook --in @-` (stdin, never argv), `CAPCLI_SECRET_NOTIFY_SLACK_WEBHOOK` in the harness env, or external client RPC — then retry notify; or dispatch via a configured channel

lines.$example: Unconfigured channels fail closed; notifications are never silently dropped.
